At Stay With My Pet, our core values guide every decision and every connection within our community. Everything begins with love and compassion — for pets, for people, and for the bonds between them. We prioritise safety, transparency, and responsible care, because every profile and every trusted connection matters. We believe in the power of community — in building friendships, supporting one another, and showing respect for both animals’ needs and people’s boundaries. And at the heart of it all is joy and wellbeing — because a shared moment with a pet can brighten a day, strengthen connections, and bring more warmth into life.

Safety Guidelines
A safe and caring experience starts with clear expectations
Stay With My Pet is a community-based platform where animal wellbeing and mutual
Safety isn’t about rules for the sake of rules — it’s about thoughtful choices,
General principles for everyone
A pet’s wellbeing always comes first
Communication should be honest and clear
All important expectations should be agreed before care begins
If something is unclear, ask — assumptions rarely help
For Pet Parents
Clarity and preparation create a safe stay
As a pet parent, your role is to give your pet friend a clear and honest picture
Complete your pet’s profile thoughtfully
Your pet’s profile is the foundation for finding the right match. Please make su
describe daily routines (feeding, walks, rest)
share personality traits and behavioural characteristics
note any health-related needs, medications, or allergies
mention situations that may cause stress or anxiety
The more accurate the information, the calmer the experience for everyone.
Agree on details before care starts
Before confirming care, discuss:
where and when care will take place
daily routines and house rules
how you’ll communicate during the stay
what to do if plans change or something unexpected happens
Clear agreements create confidence for both sides.
Share essential contacts and instructions
Before care begins, make sure your pet friend has:
your up-to-date contact details
your veterinarian’s name and contact information
guidance on how to act in case of an emergency
This helps everyone respond calmly and quickly if needed.
Stay available during care
A good experience continues throughout the stay. We recommend that you:
remain reachable
answer questions clearly and calmly
provide updates if anything changes
Open communication allows care to adapt to your pet’s needs.
Leave honest feedback after care
After care ends, share your experience:
what worked well
what could be improved next time
Kind and honest feedback helps keep the community safe and trustworthy.
For Pet Friends
Experience is not required — care and responsibility are
Stay With My Pet welcomes pet friends with or without prior experience. What mat
Choose care situations that fit your schedule, comfort level, and confidence.
Choose thoughtfully and ask questions
Safe care starts with informed choices:
accept stays you feel comfortable with
ask questions before care begins
be honest if something feels too challenging
Asking questions is a sign of responsibility.
Follow the agreed routine
Pets feel safest when:
their daily rhythm stays familiar
feeding, walks, play, and rest follow agreed routines
care is calm, attentive, and consistent
If you notice changes, inform the pet parent.
Be present and attentive
A great pet friend:
is genuinely present, not rushed
observes the pet’s mood and behaviour
stays calm in unexpected situations
You don’t need to know everything — what matters is care, awareness, and asking
If something feels uncertain
If:
a pet’s behaviour or condition changes
you’re unsure how to proceed
a situation feels unusual
contact the pet parent or reach out to us.
You’re not alone — we’re here to support you.
Emergencies and unexpected situations
Accidents are rare, but preparedness brings peace of mind. We recommend that you
know the pet’s veterinary details
keep the pet parent’s contact information accessible
act calmly and responsibly
If urgent action is required, the pet’s wellbeing always comes first.
Respect and trust within the community
Stay With My Pet is built on mutual respect:
communicate kindly and respectfully
honour agreements
give feedback honestly and constructively
Every experience helps shape a caring and safe community.
When you need support or have questions
If anything feels unclear or you need help, don’t hesitate to get in touch.
We’re here to support — not to judge or penalise.
Creating safer experiences together
Safety is not the responsibility of one person alone.
It’s a shared commitment to care, awareness, and trust.
